scope: All 46 skill headings visible on the public Templar skills page, with base descriptions and available properties. Variant counts are source-reported; individual variants are not separately enumerated.
discrepancy: MetaRoad page header says 47 skills and 498 variants; 46 rendered skill headings add up to 492 variants. This import preserves all visible entries and does not invent an additional skill.

skills.name: Dodge

skills.name: Decisive Strike

skills.name: Desperate Strike
skills.description: Deals 133.2% ATK + 100 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m and increases Enmity. Restores 120 MP.

skills.name: Pummel

skills.name: Doom Shield
skills.description: Rushes to a target within 20m and deals 219% ATK + 1254 damage. Has a 75% chance to inflict Knockdown for 3s. Grants a Protective Shield that blocks damage equaling 5% Max HP for 5s on hit. Triggers [Judgment] for 3s. 100% chance to inflict Knockdown on NPC targets. 20 Stagger Gauge Damage

specializations.effect: Resets cooldown on defeating an enemy

skills.name: Punishment
skills.description: Selects a target within 20m and deals 430.5–1291.5% ATK + 1394–4184 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m of the target and grants the Executor effect to the caster for 20s. Executor: Increases Accuracy by 200, PvE Damage Boost by 20%, and PvP Damage Boost by 10% Max 3 Charge Levels 20-35 Stagger Gauge Damage

specializations.effect: Inflicts Damage over Time to target on hit
Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit

skills.name: Shield Smite
skills.description: Deals 175.75% ATK + 173 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m. Has a 60% chance to inflict Stun on the target for 3s. Triggers [Judgment] for 2s. 100% chance to inflict Stun on NPC targets. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

specializations.effect: Removes MP Cost and restores 200 MP on hit
50% chance to trigger [Debilitating Smash] on hit

skills.name: Shield of Protection
skills.description: Temporarily increases Block Damage Reduction by 100% and guarantees Block. Restores 110 MP and Stamina once on Block.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Deals 155% ATK + 888 damage to a target within 20m and increases Enmity. Inflicts Shrink for 15s on hit and has a 50% chance to inflict Taunt for 3s if the target is a player. Shrink reduces Accuracy by 200 and Attack by 10%.

skills.name: Poach
skills.description: Deals 87.5% ATK + 49 damage to a target within 20m and pulls them in front of the caster, with a 75% chance to inflict Root for 2s. Root is guaranteed against NPC targets.

skills.name: Second Skin
skills.description: Increases PvE Damage Tolerance by 30% and PvP Damage Tolerance by 15% for 10s. Unaffected by cooldown increase effects.

skills.name: Armor of Balance
skills.description: Increases Impact-type Resist by 50% for 10s.

skills.name: Grapple
skills.description: Selects a target within 20m and deals 182.5% ATK + 1045 damage to up to 4 enemies within 7m of the target, pulling them in front of the caster. Inflicts Root for 3s.

skills.name: Noble Armor
skills.description: Increases Max HP by 5.4% for 120s and immediately restores HP by 5.4% of Max HP. Not affected by buff dispel effects.

skills.name: Judgment
skills.description: Deals 229.5% ATK + 227 damage to a target within 4m and increases Enmity.

skills.name: Comrade in Arms
skills.description: Increases caster PvE Damage Tolerance by 20% and PvP Damage Tolerance by 10%; shares incoming party member damage equally with caster for 6s within 40m.

skills.name: Defiance
skills.description: Removes Stun, Knockdown, Airborne, Grab, Frost, and Fear and grants Tenacity (Status Effect Immunity) for 5s.

skills.name: Debilitating Smash
skills.description: Deals 184% ATK + 336 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m and inflicts Debilitate for 5s on Block. Debilitate reduces Defense by 25%.

skills.name: Annihilate
skills.description: Deals 321.75% ATK + 791 damage to a Stunned or Knocked Down target within 4m; 30% Knockdown chance for 3s (guaranteed on NPCs).

skills.name: Empyrean Lord's Punishment
skills.description: Deals 164% ATK + 939 damage per hit (3 hits) to up to 4 enemies near a target within 20m; 50% Stun chance for 3s (guaranteed on NPCs).

skills.name: Nezekan's Shield
skills.description: Grants caster and party members within 40m a Protective Shield absorbing 41% Max HP for 3s.

skills.name: Capture
skills.description: Deals 121.5% ATK + 506 damage to an enemy within 20m, pulls target, inflicts Root for 3s and has 75% Stun chance for 3s (guaranteed on NPCs).

skills.name: Flash Rampage
skills.description: Deals 108% ATK + 152 damage per hit (4 hits) to a target afflicted with Stagger within 4m and increases Enmity.

skills.name: Warding Strike
skills.description: Deals 212.5% ATK + 388 damage to up to 4 enemies near caster, restores 180–198 HP and grants Warding for 10s, increasing PvE/PvP Damage Tolerance by 20%/10%.

skills.name: Executing Blade
skills.description: Deals 233% ATK + 1335 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m, reduces Defense by 30% for 5s and deals 20% more damage to targets with Impact-type status.

skills.name: Blade Storm
skills.description: Deals 205% ATK + 1174 damage to up to 4 enemies along route to target within 10m; 50% Stun chance for 2s.

skills.name: Shield Rush
skills.description: Rushes to target within 10m after Dodge or during flight, dealing 105% ATK + 258 damage, 30% Stun chance for 3s (guaranteed on NPCs).

skills.name: Threatening Blow
skills.description: Deals 266.4% ATK + 176 damage per hit (2 hits) to up to 4 enemies within 4m, increases Enmity and restores 150 MP.

skills.name: Assault Fury
skills.description: Deals 166% ATK + 951 damage to up to 4 enemies near target within 20m; 30% Stun chance for 3s (guaranteed on NPCs); Defense increases up to 20% based on targets hit.

skills.name: Enhance Health
skills.description: Increases HP by 250, Max HP by 7.5% and Incoming Heal by 6%.

skills.name: Warding Shield
skills.description: Increases Block by 200 and restores 53–64 HP on Block. Cooldown: 3s.

skills.name: Punishing Benediction
skills.description: Increases Critical Hit by 100; 50% chance to deal 38% ATK + 69 extra damage on attack while buff active.

skills.name: Ironclad Defense
skills.description: Increases Defense by 7% and Endurance by 1%.

skills.name: Guarding Seal
skills.description: Protective Shield absorbs 21% Max HP for 30s when HP is 50% or less. Cooldown: 60s.

skills.name: Impact Hit
skills.description: Increases Impact-type Chance by 11.2% and Double Chance by 0.3%.

skills.name: Insulting Roar
skills.description: Increases Enmity Boost by 100% and Attack by 5.5% for 5s on Front Attack. Cooldown: 5s.

skills.name: Fury
skills.description: Increases Front Attack Damage Boost by 0.3%; on Block grants party PvE Damage Boost 5.5% and PvP Damage Boost 2.75% for 20s.

skills.name: Survival Willpower
skills.description: Increases Status Effect Resist by 17%; grants PvE/PvP Damage Tolerance on certain incapacitating effects.

skills.name: Block Pain
skills.description: Grants Block Pain for 10s when hit; increases PvE Damage Tolerance by 11% and PvP Damage Tolerance by 5.5%. Cooldown: 20s.
